title: Binary search on a lab balance
label: Lab balance: console on knurled feet, pillar, tapered graduated beam, thin pointer over a scale, dished pans on V stirrups. In front, an angled case of sixteen graded knob weights in ring wells, a slot rail, two bound markers, a name plate.
caption: Each try weighs the sample against the middle weight still standing; the half that cannot hold the answer sinks into its wells and the bound markers close in, so sixteen weights take four tries. Drag along the weights to run the search.
